en: Colorized historic postcard view of a town square with a large stone fountain in the foreground, topped by a nude classical-style statue. Around the square stand several multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs and shopfronts at street level. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk near the buildings. The sky is softly tinted blue and peach. Printed titles at the top read "Grimma." on the left and "Markt mit Brunnen." on the right.
